header: scripts/eds-panel.ts: runs the PANEL of new questions through the real engine (no store: every question is generated fresh) and writes a compact report, so that I can judge a change to the engine on MANY kinds of question at once, not on the last one that looked wrong. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/eds-panel.ts [P01 P05 ...] (no ids: all) EDS_OUT=path writes the full JSON
